verdict.rationale: Bruno states plainly that it is not training AI models on user data and has zero visibility into requests: no cloud sync, no account, and an offline-only design. Its AI features are bring-your-own-key, with no data routed through Bruno servers, and can point at local models such as Ollama or LM Studio. Ultimate admins can also restrict which providers and models are allowed. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on verification of the no-training claim, and a formal privacy-policy or contractual commitment; training controls for third-party BYOK providers are left to those providers.
